result.summary: Found a critical readability failure in the promo banner due to white text on a light background, plus blurry restaurant thumbnails and inconsistent time-badge formatting.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout...' is white on a very light mint background, resulting in extremely low contrast and nearly unreadable text.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color on the light background or darken the banner background to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements

issues.description: Restaurant thumbnails in 'Fastest near you' section appear blurry / low-resolution, especially the burger and poke bowl images, compared to sharp UI text around them.
issues.suggestion: Replace with high-resolution optimized images and ensure proper loading without excessive blur or compression

issues.description: Delivery time badges use inconsistent formatting: '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' vs '20-30 min' with spaces around hyphen on the third card.
issues.suggestion: Standardize to a single format with consistent spacing and hyphen/en-dash usage across all badges
